title: David Ferrie's mysterious death
summary: Peter Levenda tells of David Ferrie's mysterious death, about 1967 at New Orleans, Louisiana, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He commits suicide or is suicided under mysterious circumstances during the investigation into the Kennedy assassination.

plain: A researcher and author named Peter Levenda, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, tells of a man named David Ferrie in New Orleans around 1967. Levenda says Ferrie died during an investigation into the killing of President John F. Kennedy, an inquiry tied to a New Orleans prosecutor named Jim Garrison, and that he either killed himself or was killed in a way made to look like it, under mysterious circumstances. Told this way, it hints that someone may have wanted him silenced.
